data.one_liner: An autocomplete search widget with customizable suggestions, validation, and keyboard navigation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable search field that displays an overlay list of suggestions based on user input. It supports dynamic item heights, custom widgets for list items, network-based lazy loading, and validation.
use_when: You need an autocomplete text input with search suggestions.
You require custom widgets and decorations inside suggestion lists.
You need keyboard navigation support for desktop platforms.
avoid_when: You require a complex multi-field form builder with built-in state management solutions.
strengths: Highly customizable input decoration, suggestions decoration, and item widgets.
Supports keyboard navigation for desktop apps.
Allows dynamic positioning of suggestions and lazy loading from the network.
weaknesses: Requires manual handling of asynchronous filtering and state management for network suggestions.
